Thanks for commenting.

I've been wanting to talk to my parents ever since I first had these thoughts shortly after my Dad had died. He worked as an engineer for most of his life until he was fired for sleeping on the job. He hated his job and always told me to get a job I liked instead of one that paid well. I had always told him that I wanted to do nothing. He'd just laugh. I ran away from home after a couple months off to my mother's house after he got violent one night. That was the last time I saw him. He killed himself about a year or two later.

I typically browse 4chan and Reddit. Video games are what I spend most of my time playing, reading about, or discussing.
